note: GTA VI collectible registry. Collectibles are the highest-density coordinate dataset in any GTA title — typically 50–200 items each with a unique map location. Coordinates in game-cartesian system — see data/gta-6/world/map.json. Economy relevance: collectibles provide GTA$ rewards, unique items, or unlock content that affects income capacity.

fields.name: string — display name or descriptor
fields.reward_type: string — gta$ | item | unlock | stat-boost | none
fields.reward_gta$: number | null — GTA$ reward if applicable
fields.reward_item: string | null — item name if reward is an item
fields.collection_set_id: string | null — parent collection set ID
fields.collection_set_bonus: number | null — bonus GTA$ for completing full set

day1_checklist: Identify all collectible types from GTA VI wiki Categories and in-game UI
Assign type IDs from collectible_types or add new types
Record game-cartesian coordinates from community mapping (MapGenie, GTAForums)
Note GTA$ rewards and collection set bonuses
Flag any collectibles with income-relevant unlocks (business discounts, property access, etc.)
Add collection set completion bonuses to income-sources.json
